initial.title: Podcast directory submission gate packet and blocked disposition
initial.goal: Complete every repo-side non-submission deliverable for directory-submission execution while preserving the explicit operator authorization gate.
initial.required_outcome: A redaction-safe #264 handoff packet exists for The Cognitive Stack with exact terminal dependency proof, provider authorization template, initialized submission ledger, monitoring/rollback runbook, and machine validation that no provider submission, account mutation, directory acceptance, destination-link activation, or public-launch claim is retained.
authority_boundary: Issue #264 owns only repo-side non-submission preparation unless a later explicit operator authorization names provider submissions.

The 2026-09-02 ownership assignment authorizes completing non-submission deliverables and preserving the external action gate; it does not authorize provider account access, mailbox-code use, directory submission, website destination-link activation, or public launch.
Issue #51 is a parent coordination surface and must not be closed unless child truth permits a terminal parent disposition.
operator_constraints: Use typed C-SDLC v2 lifecycle only
Use a dedicated FastWork issue worktree and issue-bound session goal
Run one bounded exact-head review before publication
Do not submit to Apple Podcasts, Spotify, Amazon Music, YouTube, or any other directory
Do not access or mutate provider accounts
Do not retain credentials, verification codes, recovery material, mailbox content, private screenshots, or provider session state
Do not activate site directory links before live provider URLs are verified under explicit authorization
initial.task_boundary: Deliver only issue #264 non-submission gate materials and truthfully preserve the operator authorization blocker.
deliverables: Operator authorization template naming provider-specific actions that remain blocked
Submission ledger initialized with no submissions and redaction-safe evidence shape
Monitoring and rollback runbook for future authorized execution
Blocked disposition summary for #51 parent coordination
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Terminal #261, #262, and #263 are validated as canonical prerequisites before #264 publication.
AC-2: The packet identifies Apple Podcasts, Spotify for Creators, Amazon Music for Podcasters, and YouTube RSS ingestion as provider targets without performing any provider action.

AC-3: The authorization template requires explicit future operator approval per provider before account, mailbox, verification, submission, status-monitoring, correction, rollback, or destination-link activation work.
AC-4: The initialized ledger records no submission and retains no credential, verification-code, private account, or unsupported acceptance material.

AC-5: Monitoring, correction, rollback, and destination-link activation rules preserve evidence and fail closed on duplicate shows, provider warnings, rejected states, payment/monetization prompts, personal-account recovery, or legal/rights uncertainty.
AC-6: #51 parent handoff says #264 is non-submission-complete but externally blocked, not provider-submitted or publicly launched.
dependencies: Future explicit operator authorization before any external provider action
non_goals: Closing #51 without a truthful parent disposition
initial.plan_summary: Initialize #264, validate terminal podcast prerequisites, implement the non-submission gate packet, run focused proof, obtain exact-head review, publish, finish if the blocked-disposition PR is accepted, and leave external provider work gated.

steps.action: Create authorization, ledger, monitoring, rollback, and parent-handoff materials without provider mutation.
Run focused proof and exact-head review before publication.

invariants: No provider account action without future explicit operator authorization
No unsupported provider acceptance or public-launch claim
Destination links activate only after live canonical provider URLs are verified
Parent #51 truth remains a coordination view, not child implementation
risks: A future operator may need to choose per-provider visibility and terms decisions.
Provider UI behavior can change after the #263 sampled official instructions.
A blocked disposition can be overread as submission completion unless the packet is explicit.
stop_conditions: Any provider account action would be required
Any credential, verification code, mailbox content, or private provider data would be retained
Any claim implies a directory listing is live or accepted

validation_lanes.proof_role: Validate non-submission gate packet, initialized ledger, redaction boundary, provider census, and #51 parent handoff truth.
validation_lanes.defer_reason: Run after the non-submission gate packet exists; any retained submission, secret-like material, or destination-link activation claim blocks publication.

validation_lanes.proof_role: Validate #261, #262, and #263 terminal caches before publication.
validation_lanes.defer_reason: Run after bind and before publication; any noncanonical dependency blocks #264.

validation_lanes.proof_role: Reject malformed tracked changes before exact-head review.
validation_lanes.defer_reason: Run after the issue has a bounded candidate diff.

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed on dependency drift, provider-action ambiguity, secret retention, unsupported public claim, destination-link overclaim, review drift, or parent-child truth mismatch.
review_prompts: Does the candidate complete all repo-side #264 deliverables without submitting to any provider?
Does it make the future operator authorization gate unmistakable and per-provider?
Does the #51 handoff truth avoid closing or overclaiming parent completion?
initial.review_scope: Review issue #264 non-submission gate packet, validation evidence, operator authorization boundary, #51 parent handoff truth, and exact terminal dependency proof.
